content.comment_body: In the app, under Control, it asks for tags. If I configure a network input in the program with my phone's IP address, is it possible to use the app's buttons as network inputs? What exactly are the tags?
It would be helpful if you could mention which app you are referring to.
Sorry, it's the only app I'm familiar with... [url]
The information I referenced was from the first manual. I'll review the second one now, thanks. [IMAGE]
What should I select as the 'device type' in the app on my phone? I want to use the phone to trigger a network input on the PLC— is this even possible? It doesn’t appear to be. [IMAGE]
A new question from AutoGen_1071368 has been moved to a separate thread titled 'Why does the new App [version_no] crash without reason?' Best regards [user_name]

Hi, As far as I know, that's not directly possible. The app can control specific bits in [product_name] memory, like V0.0. You can set a network digital input in your [product_name] program to use V0.0. Hope this clarifies things.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having difficulty figuring out how to use a mobile app with their PLC system to activate network inputs, including questions about configuring tags and selecting device types. There is uncertainty about whether the phone can function as a network input, and the manuals do not fully explain how the app interacts with the modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the app to clearly enable using their phone as a network input device for the PLC, with straightforward guidance on configuring device type and tags, along with easy, in-app instructions for mapping app buttons to network inputs.
